newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fukutoku says hard to recover loans to NCB units.
newsitem.headline: Fukutoku says hard to recover loans to NCB units.

text.p: Fukutoku Bank Ltd said on Thursday it may have difficulty collecting loans extended to two clients that are affiliates of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd.
The clients were among three NCB non-bank financial affiliates that filed for bankruptcy at Tokyo District Court on Tuesday.
Fukutoku, a regional bank based in Osaka, western Japan, said in a statement it had extended loans totalling 2.06 billion yen to the two firms.
It said there may be a long delay in collecting on the loans or that it may not be able to collect on them at all.
Fukutoku has already set aside 1.01 billion yen in reserves in the year to March 31, 1997, to cover possible losses on loans to the two clients.
